question_en: Which statements are true? 1) rays parallel to the principal axis pass through the focus after a converging lens; 2) a ray through the optical centre is not refracted; 3) for $d>2F$ a diverging lens gives a real image; 4) a convex glass lens is converging in water too; 5) the optical power of a diverging lens is positive.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) bosh optik o'qqa parallel nurlar yig'uvchi linzadan keyin fokusdan o'tadi; 2) optik markazdan o'tgan nur sinmaydi; 3) $d>2F$ da sochuvchi linza haqiqiy tasvir beradi; 4) shisha qavariq linza suvda ham yig'uvchi; 5) sochuvchi linzaning optik kuchi musbat.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) лучи, параллельные главной оптической оси, после собирающей линзы проходят через фокус; 2) луч через оптический центр не преломляется; 3) при $d>2F$ рассеивающая линза даёт действительное изображение; 4) стеклянная выпуклая линза и в воде собирающая; 5) оптическая сила рассеивающей линзы положительна.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Sochuvchi linza har doim mavhum tasvir beradi (3 noto'g'ri), uning optik kuchi manfiy (5 noto'g'ri); shisha uchun n > n(suv).
Asos: nur yurishi, D = 1/F.

en: 3 and 5 are false, 4 is true: $$F<0\ \Rightarrow\ f<0,\ D<0;\qquad \frac{1.5}{4/3}-1>0$$

distractors.C: sochuvchi linza haqiqiy tasvir beradi deb olingan, 1-fikr tushib qolgan
distractors.D: sochuvchi linza optik kuchi musbat deb olingan, 2-fikr tushib qolgan
distractors.E: sochuvchi linza optik kuchi musbat deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что рассеивающая линза даёт действительное изображение, пропущено 1
distractors_ru.D: оптическая сила рассеивающей линзы принята положительной, пропущено 2
distractors_ru.E: оптическая сила рассеивающей линзы принята положительной

distractors_en.A: statement 4 (a glass lens in water) was missed
distractors_en.C: a diverging lens was taken to give a real image, statement 1 was missed
distractors_en.D: the power of a diverging lens was taken as positive, statement 2 was missed
distractors_en.E: the power of a diverging lens was taken as positive

question_en: An object is $40\ \mathrm{cm}$ from a converging lens of focal length $24\ \mathrm{cm}$. How far from the lens (in centimetres) is the image formed?
question_uz: Buyum fokus masofasi $24\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan yig'uvchi linzadan $40\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofada turibdi. Tasvir linzadan necha santimetr masofada hosil bo'ladi?
question_ru: Предмет находится на расстоянии $40\ \mathrm{cm}$ от собирающей линзы с фокусным расстоянием $24\ \mathrm{cm}$. На каком расстоянии от линзы (в сантиметрах) получится изображение?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. 1/f = 1/24 − 1/40 = 1/60, f = 60 cm (haqiqiy tasvir, F < d < 2F).
Asos: yupqa linza formulasi.

distractors_en.B: the focal length was taken as the answer
distractors_en.D: the difference d − F was taken
distractors_en.E: the sum d + F was taken

question_en: The focal length of a diverging lens is $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. What is its optical power in dioptres?
question_uz: Sochuvchi linzaning fokus masofasi $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Uning optik kuchi necha dioptriya?
question_ru: Фокусное расстояние рассеивающей линзы $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Чему равна её оптическая сила (в диоптриях)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. D = 1/F, F = −0.125 m (sochuvchi linza), D = −8 D.
Asos: optik kuch, F metrda.

distractors.D: F santimetrda olingan va ishorasi unutilgan

distractors_ru.D: F взято в сантиметрах и забыт знак

distractors_en.B: the sign of a diverging lens was forgotten
distractors_en.D: F was taken in centimetres and the sign forgotten
distractors_en.E: the focal length was taken as the answer

question_en: An object is between the focus and the double focus of a converging lens ($F<d<2F$). Choose the properties of the image: 1) real; 2) virtual; 3) inverted; 4) upright; 5) magnified; 6) diminished.
question_uz: Buyum yig'uvchi linzaning fokusi bilan ikkilangan fokusi orasida ($F<d<2F$) turibdi. Tasvirning xossalarini tanlang: 1) haqiqiy; 2) mavhum; 3) teskari; 4) to'g'ri; 5) kattalashgan; 6) kichiklashgan.
question_ru: Предмет находится между фокусом и двойным фокусом собирающей линзы ($F<d<2F$). Выберите свойства изображения: 1) действительное; 2) мнимое; 3) перевёрнутое; 4) прямое; 5) увеличенное; 6) уменьшенное.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. F < d < 2F da f > 2F: tasvir haqiqiy, teskari, kattalashgan (proyektor).
Asos: tasvir yasash holatlari.

distractors.E: tasvir mavhum, lekin teskari deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the case d < F (magnifier) was taken
distractors_en.C: a real image was taken to be upright
distractors_en.E: the image was taken as virtual but inverted

question_en: The focal length of a magnifier is $4\ \mathrm{cm}$. How many times does it magnify when the image is formed at the distance of best vision ($25\ \mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: Lupaning fokus masofasi $4\ \mathrm{cm}$. Tasvir eng yaxshi ko'rish masofasida ($25\ \mathrm{cm}$) hosil bo'lganda lupa necha marta kattalashtiradi?
question_ru: Фокусное расстояние лупы $4\ \mathrm{cm}$. Во сколько раз увеличивает лупа, если изображение получается на расстоянии наилучшего зрения ($25\ \mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Tasvir d₀ da: Γ = d₀/F + 1 = 25/4 + 1 = 7.25.
Asos: lupa kattalashtirishi.

distractors_en.A: the image was taken at infinity (d₀/F)

question_en: The radius of curvature of the convex surface of a plano-convex lens made of glass with refractive index $1.5$ is $30\ \mathrm{cm}$. What is the focal length of the lens in air in centimetres?
question_uz: Sindirish ko'rsatkichi $1.5$ bo'lgan shishadan yasalgan yassi-qavariq linzaning qavariq sirti egrilik radiusi $30\ \mathrm{cm}$. Linzaning havodagi fokus masofasi necha santimetr?
question_ru: Радиус кривизны выпуклой поверхности плосковыпуклой линзы из стекла с показателем преломления $1.5$ равен $30\ \mathrm{cm}$. Чему равно фокусное расстояние линзы в воздухе (в сантиметрах)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Yassi sirt uchun 1/R = 0: 1/F = (n − 1)/R, F = 30/0.5 = 60 cm.
Asos: linza yasovchilar formulasi.

distractors.E: ikki sirt olinib, n − 1 o'rniga 1 qo'yilgan

distractors_ru.E: взяты две поверхности, вместо n − 1 подставлено 1

distractors_en.A: both surfaces were taken as convex
distractors_en.C: the radius was divided by n
distractors_en.D: the radius was multiplied by n
distractors_en.E: two surfaces were taken and 1 was used instead of n − 1

question_en: The ground was photographed from an aircraft flying at a height of $4\ \mathrm{km}$ with an objective of focal length $16\ \mathrm{cm}$. What is the scale of the picture?
question_uz: $4\ \mathrm{km}$ balandlikda uchayotgan samolyotdan fokus masofasi $16\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan obyektiv bilan joy suratga olindi. Suratning masshtabi qanday?
question_ru: С самолёта, летящего на высоте $4\ \mathrm{km}$, местность сфотографировали объективом с фокусным расстоянием $16\ \mathrm{cm}$. Каков масштаб снимка?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Tasvir fokal tekislikda: Γ = F/H = 0.16 m / 4000 m = 1/25000.
Asos: fotoapparat, d ≫ F.

distractors.A: F santimetrdagi son metr deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: число сантиметров F принято за метры

distractors_en.A: the number of centimetres in F was taken as metres
distractors_en.B: the height was taken as 400 m
distractors_en.D: the height was taken as 40 km
distractors_en.E: the height was multiplied by F

question_en: A long-sighted person wearing glasses of optical power $+3\ \mathrm{D}$ reads a book at $25\ \mathrm{cm}$. At least how far from the eyes (in centimetres) must the person hold the book without glasses?
question_uz: Uzoqdan ko'radigan kishi optik kuchi $+3\ \mathrm{D}$ bo'lgan ko'zoynak taqib, kitobni $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ dan o'qiydi. Ko'zoynaksiz u kitobni ko'zidan kamida necha santimetr uzoqlikda tutishi kerak?
question_ru: Дальнозоркий человек в очках с оптической силой $+3\ \mathrm{D}$ читает книгу с $25\ \mathrm{cm}$. На каком наименьшем расстоянии от глаз (в сантиметрах) он должен держать книгу без очков?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. D = 1/d₀ − 1/d: 3 = 4 − 1/d, d = 1 m = 100 cm.
Asos: ko'zoynak optik kuchi.

distractors.D: eng yaxshi ko'rish masofasi javob deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: за ответ принято расстояние наилучшего зрения

distractors_en.B: the power was added to 4 (sign error)
distractors_en.C: only the focal length of the glasses was taken
distractors_en.D: the distance of best vision was taken as the answer
distractors_en.E: d₀ was multiplied by the optical power

question_en: The focal length of the objective of a Keplerian telescope is $1\ \mathrm{m}$ and of the eyepiece $2.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. What are the magnification $\Gamma$ and the length $L$ (in centimetres) of the telescope?
question_uz: Kepler teleskopi obyektivining fokus masofasi $1\ \mathrm{m}$, okulyarniki $2.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Teleskop kattalashtirishi $\Gamma$ va uzunligi $L$ (santimetrda) qancha?
question_ru: Фокусное расстояние объектива телескопа Кеплера $1\ \mathrm{m}$, окуляра $2.5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Чему равны увеличение телескопа $\Gamma$ и его длина $L$ (в сантиметрах)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Γ = F₁/F₂ = 100/2.5 = 40, L = F₁ + F₂ = 102.5 cm.
Asos: teleskop kattalashtirishi.

distractors.A: uzunlik F₁ − F₂ deb olingan (Galiley teleskopi)

distractors_ru.C: F₁ оставлено в метрах, F₂ в сантиметрах
distractors_ru.E: F₁ взято в миллиметрах, F₂ в сантиметрах

distractors_en.A: the length was taken as F₁ − F₂ (Galilean telescope)
distractors_en.C: F₁ was left in metres and F₂ in centimetres
distractors_en.E: F₁ was taken in millimetres and F₂ in centimetres

question_en: A converging lens of focal length $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ and a diverging lens of focal length $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ are put in close contact. What is the optical power of the system in dioptres?
question_uz: Fokus masofasi $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan yig'uvchi va fokus masofasi $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan sochuvchi linzalar bir-biriga zich tegizildi. Tizimning optik kuchi necha dioptriya?
question_ru: Собирающую линзу с фокусным расстоянием $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ и рассеивающую линзу с фокусным расстоянием $12.5\ \mathrm{cm}$ сложили вплотную. Чему равна оптическая сила системы (в диоптриях)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. D₁ = 1/0.2 = 5 D, D₂ = 1/(−0.125) = −8 D, D = 5 − 8 = −3 D (sochuvchi tizim).
Asos: D = D₁ + D₂.

distractors_en.A: both lenses were taken as converging
distractors_en.C: both lenses were taken as diverging
distractors_en.D: the focal length (m) was found without sign

question_en: Which statements are true? 1) for glass $n$ is larger for violet light than for red; 2) the focal length of a converging lens is larger for red light than for violet; 3) in glass violet light is faster than red; 4) the colour of light changes on entering water; 5) on refraction the frequency does not change and $\lambda$ decreases $n$ times.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) shishada $n$ binafsha nur uchun qizildan katta; 2) yig'uvchi linza fokus masofasi qizil nur uchun binafshanikidan katta; 3) shishada binafsha nur qizildan tez; 4) suvga o'tganda yorug'lik rangi o'zgaradi; 5) sinishda chastota o'zgarmaydi, $\lambda$ esa $n$ marta kamayadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) для стекла $n$ в фиолетовом свете больше, чем в красном; 2) фокусное расстояние собирающей линзы для красного света больше, чем для фиолетового; 3) в стекле фиолетовый свет быстрее красного; 4) при переходе в воду цвет света меняется; 5) при преломлении частота не меняется, а $\lambda$ уменьшается в $n$ раз.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. v = c/n: binafsha nur shishada sekinroq (3 noto'g'ri); rang chastota bilan aniqlanadi va o'zgarmaydi (4 noto'g'ri).
Asos: dispersiya.

distractors.C: binafsha nur shishada tezroq deb olingan, 1-fikr tushib qolgan
distractors.D: rang o'zgaradi deb olingan, 2-fikr tushib qolgan

distractors_ru.C: фиолетовый свет принят более быстрым, пропущено 1
distractors_ru.E: принято, что в воде цвет меняется

distractors_en.C: violet light was taken as faster, statement 1 was missed
distractors_en.D: the colour was taken to change, statement 2 was missed
distractors_en.E: the colour was taken to change in water

question_en: The focal length of a projector objective is $0.25\ \mathrm{m}$. How far from the objective (in metres) must the screen be placed to obtain an image of the slide magnified $19$ times?
question_uz: Proyeksion apparat obyektivining fokus masofasi $0.25\ \mathrm{m}$. Ekranda diapozitivning $19$ marta kattalashgan tasvirini olish uchun ekranni obyektivdan necha metr uzoqqa qo'yish kerak?
question_ru: Фокусное расстояние объектива проекционного аппарата $0.25\ \mathrm{m}$. На каком расстоянии от объектива (в метрах) нужно поставить экран, чтобы получить изображение диапозитива, увеличенное в $19$ раз?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Γ = (f − F)/F, demak f = F(Γ + 1) = 0.25 · 20 = 5 m.
Asos: proyektor kattalashtirishi.

distractors_ru.D: найдено расстояние от диапозитива до экрана
distractors_ru.E: найдено расстояние от диапозитива до объектива

distractors_en.D: the distance from the slide to the screen was found
distractors_en.E: the distance from the slide to the objective was found

question_en: A converging lens gives a real image of an object diminished $4$ times. When the object was moved $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ closer to the lens, the image became diminished $2$ times. What is the focal length of the lens in centimetres?
question_uz: Yig'uvchi linza buyumning $4$ marta kichiklashgan haqiqiy tasvirini bermoqda. Buyum linzaga $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ yaqinlashtirilganda tasvir $2$ marta kichiklashgan bo'ldi. Linzaning fokus masofasi necha santimetr?
question_ru: Собирающая линза даёт действительное изображение предмета, уменьшенное в $4$ раза. Когда предмет приблизили к линзе на $15\ \mathrm{cm}$, изображение стало уменьшенным в $2$ раза. Чему равно фокусное расстояние линзы (в сантиметрах)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Haqiqiy tasvir uchun d = F(1 + 1/Γ): d₁ = 5F, d₂ = 3F, 2F = 15 cm, F = 7.5 cm.
Asos: Γ = F/(d − F).

distractors.B: siljish fokus masofasiga teng deb olingan
distractors.C: tasvirlar 4 va 2 marta kattalashgan deb olingan
distractors.D: siljish ikkinchi masofa 3F ga teng deb olingan
distractors.E: siljish birinchi masofa 5F ga teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: изображения приняты увеличенными в 4 и 2 раза

distractors_en.B: the shift was taken equal to the focal length
distractors_en.C: the images were taken as magnified 4 and 2 times
distractors_en.D: the shift was taken equal to the second distance 3F
distractors_en.E: the shift was taken equal to the first distance 5F

question_en: The figure shows a converging lens, its foci $F$, double foci $2F$, an object $MN$ and numbered regions. In which region is the image of the object formed?
question_uz: Rasmda yig'uvchi linza, uning fokuslari $F$, ikkilangan fokuslari $2F$, $MN$ buyum va raqamlangan sohalar ko'rsatilgan. Buyumning tasviri qaysi sohada hosil bo'ladi?
question_ru: На рисунке показаны собирающая линза, её фокусы $F$, двойные фокусы $2F$, предмет $MN$ и пронумерованные области. В какой области получится изображение предмета?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Buyum F va 2F orasida, demak tasvir linzaning narigi tomonida 2F dan keyin — 4-sohada.
Asos: F < d < 2F ⇒ f > 2F.

distractors.A: tasvir mavhum deb olingan (d < F holati)
distractors.B: tasvir linza va fokus orasida deb olingan
distractors.C: d > 2F holati olingan (F va 2F orasidagi tasvir)

distractors_ru.B: изображение принято между линзой и фокусом
distractors_ru.C: взят случай d > 2F (изображение между F и 2F)

distractors_en.A: the image was taken as virtual (case d < F)
distractors_en.B: the image was taken between the lens and the focus
distractors_en.C: the case d > 2F was taken (image between F and 2F)
distractors_en.E: the image was taken on the object's side

question_en: The focal length of a converging glass lens with refractive index $1.5$ is $F_1$ in air, $F_2$ in water ($n_0=1.33$) and $F_3$ (with sign) in a liquid of refractive index $1.7$. Which relation between them is correct?
question_uz: Sindirish ko'rsatkichi $1.5$ bo'lgan shisha yig'uvchi linzaning fokus masofasi havoda $F_1$, suvda ($n_0=1.33$) $F_2$, sindirish ko'rsatkichi $1.7$ bo'lgan suyuqlikda $F_3$ (ishorasi bilan). Ular orasidagi to'g'ri munosabat qaysi?
question_ru: Фокусное расстояние стеклянной собирающей линзы с показателем преломления $1.5$ в воздухе $F_1$, в воде ($n_0=1.33$) $F_2$, в жидкости с показателем преломления $1.7$ — $F_3$ (со знаком). Какое соотношение между ними верно?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. n/n₀ − 1: havoda 0.5, suvda ≈ 0.13, suyuqlikda < 0. Demak F₂ > F₁ > 0, F₃ < 0 (linza sochuvchi).
Asos: linza yasovchilar formulasi.

distractors.B: fokus masofasi muhitga bog'liq emas deb olingan
distractors.C: suvda fokus masofasi kamayadi deb olingan
distractors.D: zichroq muhitda F kamayadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что фокусное расстояние не зависит от среды
distractors_ru.C: принято, что в воде фокусное расстояние уменьшается
distractors_ru.D: принято, что в более плотной среде F уменьшается

distractors_en.A: the sign of F₃ was ignored (magnitude taken)
distractors_en.B: the focal length was taken as independent of the medium
distractors_en.C: the focal length was taken to decrease in water
distractors_en.D: F was taken to decrease in a denser medium
